searches_tried: Local comps.py (pipeline and work) for engineer vice, bench vice, swivel vice, record vice. No web search done: generic low-value hand tool. 49 Gowans bench vice hammers since 2024: median $60, mostly $30-80 for small vices. eBay sold would settle only marginally.
